card.name: Laws banning or prohibiting something
card.fires_on: The verb ban or prohibit (banned, bans, prohibits) in descriptions of laws and regulations, and the small words right after it, such as the, of, any, and. It fires where the text is about to name what is forbidden.

modes.label: Ban verb itself
modes.description: The verb ban or prohibit in a sentence about a law or regulation.
modes.example: In 2007, the U.S. Congress passed the Energy Independence and Security Act which contains a subsection that<< bans>> the sale of incandescent light bulbs

modes.label: Word after the ban verb
modes.description: A small word following banning or bans that leads into the banned thing.
modes.example: concern was enough to warrant the U.S. government banning<< the>> use of BPA in baby b

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that name what is forbidden or concern government rules, though the output tokens are mixed.
card.plain: It lights up when a law or rule is described as banning or prohibiting something, right up to the point where the banned thing is named.
